## Summary

Describe the problem, chosen change, and why this is the smallest complete
correction.

## Change class

- [ ] Editorial correction
- [ ] Material framework change
- [ ] Example or guidance change
- [ ] Pilot or review record
- [ ] Repository stewardship

## Authority and compatibility

- [ ] I identified every affected canonical statement and updated all affected surfaces.
- [ ] The change follows the charter, accepted ADRs, CONTEXT.md, and governance.
- [ ] The change is compatible with the exact adopted Commons release, or the deviation and steward decision are documented.
- [ ] Examples, pilot records, review findings, and implementations remain non-authoritative.

## Boundaries

- [ ] One-individual scope, paper-only use, selective admission, provenance, human authority, and portable exit remain intact.
- [ ] AI remains optional, source-backed, proposal- and draft-only, and unable to execute external mutations.
- [ ] No private records, credentials, confidential work, personal Journal material, source-inspiration history, or generated-by attribution is included.
- [ ] No unsupported effectiveness, safety, compliance, certification, or outcome claim is included.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. For a material change, include the
content-candidate commit and tree, independent review disposition, and release
assembly status when those gates exist.

## Risks, limitations, and dissent

Record remaining uncertainty, accepted limitations, migration consequences,
and material dissent. Write `None` only when each category has been considered.
